title: Vivid Vanilla
description: A modpack aiming to give vanilla Minecraft a visual overhaul, while maintaining the overall feeling of the game.
body:
![Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3bc45da4c36b8653a368282dd0bf4df91ad3814f.png)

# Vivid Vanilla is...
- ...**Fully client side** -> Join any server with the modpack
- ...**Support for no shaders** -> Good for both high and low-end devices.
- ...**Stunning visuals** -> For low and high-end

# Features
- Full GUI overhaul
- Mob Animations
- Full visual overhaul
- Many QOL features
- 3D items
- Dyamic lighting
- Particle effects
- And much much more...
